name: 樱桃猫猫毛绒连帽上衣
description: 白色连帽上衣：毛绒猫耳帽配红色蝴蝶结，胸前一对大樱桃刺绣和两颗毛绒球，袖子上红色 Chop Chop 字样。宽松版型，可爱又显小。可以单租，也可以和樱桃背带雪裤整套租。尺码 M。
descriptionEn: A white hooded top with a plush kitty-ear hood and red bow, big embroidered cherries on the chest, two fluffy pom-poms and red Chop Chop lettering down the sleeve. Relaxed and cute. Rent it on its own or as a full set with the matching cherry bib pants. Size M.

name: 樱桃蝴蝶结背带雪裤
description: 白色背带雪裤：红色侧边条纹，腿上樱桃蝴蝶结刺绣，配红色毛绒腰带和蝴蝶结挂饰。可以单租，也可以和樱桃猫猫上衣整套租。尺码 M。
descriptionEn: White bib snow pants with red side stripes, embroidered cherry bows on the legs, a red plush belt and a bow charm. Rent them on their own or as a full set with the matching cherry kitty hoodie. Size M.

name: 樱桃猫猫雪服（店主搭配）
nameEn: Cherry Kitty Snow Set (Styled by Sunny)
description:
樱桃猫猫毛绒连帽上衣（Chop Chop）+ 樱桃蝴蝶结背带雪裤（ISEE MIGGA）。这两件来自不同品牌，不是官方套装，但红白配色和樱桃元素完全一致，穿在一起就是一整套，比分开租更划算。尺码 M。

## 设计细节
- 毛绒猫耳帽 + 红色蝴蝶结，胸前大樱桃刺绣和毛绒球
- 背带雪裤红色侧边条纹，腿上樱桃蝴蝶结刺绣
- 红色毛绒腰带和蝴蝶结挂饰
descriptionEn:
The Cherry Kitty Plush Hoodie (Chop Chop) + the Cherry Bow Bib Snow Pants (ISEE MIGGA). They come from two different brands and aren't sold as a set, but the red-and-white colors and cherry details match perfectly — together they look like one outfit, and the set costs less than renting them separately. Size M.

## Design Details
- Plush kitty-ear hood with a red bow; big embroidered cherries and pom-poms on the chest
- Bib pants with red side stripes and embroidered cherry bows on the legs
- Red plush belt and bow charm

name: 白色涂鸦印花滑雪套装
description:
白底满印小猪、笑脸、彩虹、星星和复古电话的涂鸦图案，上衣是宽松的连帽冲锋衣，雪裤是阔腿直筒，整套俏皮又出片。尺码 M。

## 面料与科技
- 三层复合面料：外层四级防泼水（仿荷叶效果，遇水成珠），中层高密度涤纶，内层加厚 TPU 防水膜
- 防水、透气、耐磨、防风

## 设计细节
- 加高立领 + 连帽，双重防护
- 双头拉链 + 防水门襟
- 弹力防风袖口，袖口有雪卡位
- 腰部雪裙双排扣，可调节
- 雪裤带拉链口袋；裤脚防雪裙加抽绳，内侧硅胶防滑

## 尺码（M，单位 cm）
- 上衣：胸围 135 · 袖长 58.5 · 衣长 77
- 雪裤：腰围 74 · 臀围 138 · 裤长 109
descriptionEn:
A white snow suit covered in a playful doodle print of piggy banks, smiley faces, rainbows, stars and retro phones: a roomy hooded shell jacket over wide straight-leg pants. Fun and very photogenic. Size M.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer fabric: grade-4 water-repellent outer layer (water beads up like on a lotus leaf), dense polyester middle layer, thick TPU waterproof membrane inside
- Waterproof, breathable, abrasion-resistant and windproof

## Design Details
- High stand collar plus hood for double protection
- Two-way zipper with a waterproof storm flap
- Stretch windproof cuffs with a ski-pass pocket on the sleeve
- Adjustable snow skirt with double snaps
- Zip pockets on the pants; leg gaiters with drawcords and silicone grip

## Measurements (M, cm)
- Jacket: chest 135 · sleeve 58.5 · length 77
- Pants: waist 74 · hips 138 · length 109

name: 粉色毛边工装滑雪套装
description:
糖果粉工装风滑雪套装，上衣和雪裤的口袋、门襟、袖子都滚了一圈白色羊羔毛边，胸前两个毛绒翻盖口袋，雪裤是多口袋阔腿工装裤，软萌又有型。尺码 S。
合照里的浅蓝色只是同款的另一个颜色，店里只有粉色。
descriptionEn:
A candy-pink cargo-style snow suit with fluffy white sherpa trim around the pockets, placket and sleeves. The jacket has two plush flap chest pockets; the pants are wide-leg cargos with plenty of pockets. Soft and cute, but still sharp. Size S.
The light blue suit in the couple photos is another color of the same style; we only carry pink.

name: 扎染牛仔滑雪套装

items.size: 上衣 M · 裤子 S

description:
蓝色扎染牛仔纹理的套头连帽滑雪服，配多口袋宽松工装雪裤，金属标牌点缀，街头感很强，男女都能穿。尺码：上衣 M，雪裤 S。
内里加绒，比较厚实保暖，也比一般雪服重一些。

## 面料与科技
- 三层复合面料
- 防水 15000mmH₂O，透气 10000g/m²/24h
- 全压胶缝合

## 设计细节
- 防水防风雪帽，可以套在头盔外面
- 袖口雪卡包、可调节魔术贴袖口
- 可调节防风雪裙、防雪灌下摆
- 定制防水拉链
- 雪裤腰头可调节，裤脚可调节

## 尺码（单位 cm）
- 上衣 M：衣长 77 · 胸围 128 · 肩宽 56.5 · 袖长 81
- 雪裤 S：裤长 105 · 腰围 73 · 臀围 133
descriptionEn:
A blue tie-dye denim-look pullover hoodie snow jacket with roomy multi-pocket cargo pants and metal badge details. Very streetwear, and unisex. Sizes: jacket M, pants S.
The fleece lining makes it warm and thick, and a bit heavier than most snow suits.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer fabric
- Waterproof 15,000 mmH₂O, breathability 10,000 g/m²/24h
- Fully taped seams

## Design Details
- Waterproof, windproof hood that fits over a helmet
- Ski-pass pocket on the sleeve; adjustable Velcro cuffs
- Adjustable snow skirt and snow-proof hem
- Custom waterproof zippers
- Adjustable waistband and leg openings on the pants

## Measurements (cm)
- Jacket M: length 77 · chest 128 · shoulders 56.5 · sleeve 81
- Pants S: length 105 · waist 73 · hips 133
